drift: Batch drift report (T0001-T0013, read together): the rows have converged on one template. About 20 of 28 say 'X was recorded before/after Y', add a child's drawing or sticker, and end with 'the only completed count is <returned objects>, not people'. Each row is fine on its own, but a player who finds three of them has found the same clue three times, and the world sounds like one clerk. The containment rows are all timestamp-and-form jokes and the agricultural rows are all 'water total before source'; a blind reader sorts them by that alone. Keep the tone (one human detail beside one institutional one), but vary it: different human stakes (not always a child), different institutional blind spots (not always a count), clues that are mostly an arrangement of objects with a short note or none, and other spots where both sides can use them (ground, vehicle, mailbox, corpse), not only furniture.
